memory:
Writer/Instagram creator, now 600 followers, aiming to grow presence and engagement. Works on a manuscript and as a freelancer; cat Luna performs well in BTS posts. Plans manuscript snippets, BTS/UGC, and content-preference poll. Tomorrow’s Story Q&A via Question Sticker covers writing process/freel

REMINDERS (current values):
[current] user | social media presence goal: Increase presence on Instagram
[current] user | social media goal: Keep the momentum from reaching 500 followers going
[current] user | follower content preference: Followers like seeing photos of Luna
[current] user | preferred content ideas: Behind-the-scenes content and user-generated content campaigns
[current] user | content plan: Share writing-process content and manuscript snippets on Instagram Stories
[current] user | posting approach: Post manuscript snippets as sections are completed while maintaining a consistent frequency
[current] user | engagement plan: Ask followers about their content preferences
[current] user | instagram poll: Poll with 3 options: "More writing tips and advice", "More behind-the-scenes content", and "More sneak peeks of my manuscript"
[current] user | instagram poll engagement plan: Ask followers to share their thoughts and opinions in the comments section
[current] user | follow-up content plan: Create a follow-up Instagram story with a graphic or screenshot of the poll results, context, insights, a thank-you, and the winning option
[current] user | q&a format: Use the "Question Sticker" feature in Instagram Stories first
[current] user | q&a promotion plan: Announce it in advance, create a branded hashtag, and specify the topic or theme
[current] user | q&a answering plan: Answer a selection of questions and address common themes
[current] user | q&a additional resources plan: Provide additional resources if not every question can be answered
[current] user | q&a communication plan: Communicate with followers and set expectations
[current] user | q&a reminder plan: Post a quick update on Instagram Stories to remind followers about the Q&A session tomorrow
